channelTitle: Chamomile gets the credit, but this vine flower was Grandma June's real bedtime tea
hook: Chamomile gets the credit, but passionflower was Grandma June's actual bedtime secret.
remedy: Dried passionflower steeped into a mild, earthy tea is an old-fashioned home remedy for a restless mind, long used in old-time households to help settle down before bed.
steps: Steep one to two teaspoons of dried passionflower in a cup of hot water for about ten minutes, covered
Strain out the leaves and flowers
Sip it warm about thirty minutes before bed, somewhere quiet
caution: Passionflower can cause drowsiness, so don't drive or operate machinery after drinking it. Skip it if you're pregnant, nursing, or already taking sedatives or blood pressure medication, unless a doctor says it's fine.
cta: Does your family have a go-to bedtime tea, or has passionflower ever made an appearance in your house? Tell Grandma June.
